searchText: Doesn't look like it: ``` withdrawable_balance = min(state.balances[withdrawal.index] - MIN_ACTIVATION_BALANCE, withdrawal.amount) ``` `MIN_ACTIVATION_BALANCE` is 32 ETH. ah perfect, thanks <@144468805697929216> that code there underflows though so I hope it's not specified like that cause that's a bug right there 🙂 Unless there's an assert above that line lol Not an assert, but a condition is there to prevent the underflow. I would use withdrawal for the balance and exit for the validator. Withdrawal happens in both, full exit and partial withdrawal, cases, while validator exit happens only in the case of the former. From this perspective EL triggered withdrawal sounds better

Doesn't look like it:

```
withdrawable_balance = min(state.balances[withdrawal.index] - MIN_ACTIVATION_BALANCE, withdrawal.amount)
```
